id.description: Unique identifier for this building template

name.description: Display name of the building (auto-derived from id if omitted)

category.description: Functional category of the building (default: residential)

archetype.description: Procedural generator archetype (e.g. hovel, cottage, townhouse, manor, smithy, tavern, watchtower, guardpost, chapel, warehouse)

settlement_tiers.description: Settlement sizes where this building can spawn (default: all tiers)

biomes.description: Biomes where this building is culturally/environmentally appropriate (default: all biomes)

width.description: Width in tiles (inferred automatically from layout if omitted)

height.description: Height in tiles (inferred automatically from layout if omitted)

floors.description: Number of procedural floors (integer) OR multi-level vertical floor configurations (array of floor objects)

num_floors.description: Number of procedural floors (1 = ground, 2 = ground + upper, 3 = cellar + ground + upper)

wall_type.description: Default wall tile type (e.g. WoodWall, StoneWall)

floor_type.description: Default floor tile type (e.g. WoodFloor, StoneFloor)

layout.description: ASCII grid rows defining walls (#), floors (.), doors (+), stairs (>), etc.

rooms.description: Optional named room bounding boxes (automatically detected via flood-fill if omitted)
